entries.learning_activity: (c) Explore advanced tenets of coordinate geometry (angle between two lines, perpendicular distance, locus of a moving point, ratio theorem, and equations of a circle)

entries.main_competence: 1. Demonstrate mastery of some advanced concepts in Mathematics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of knowledge and skills in Mathematics
entries.learning_activity: (d) Explore advanced tenets of trigonometry (ratios, small angles, compound angles and factor formulae, trigonometric functions, trigonometric equations, inverse trigonometric functions, graphs of inverse trigonometric functions, domain, and range)
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Formulate a scenario which lead students to explore various ratios of trigonometry
Case study: Formulate a case study and through it guide students to approximate small angles, derive and apply compound angles formulae
Gallery walk: In groups, students discuss how to derive and apply factor formulae. Allow each group to post their findings and other groups walk through, note and discuss in the class
Think-Ink-Pair-Share: Allow students to discuss the concept of trigonometric functions, trigonometric equations and inverse trigonometric functions
Skills Lab: In groups, students discuss how to draw the graphs of inverse trigonometric functions and identify domain and range
entries.assessment: Advanced tenets of trigonometry are adequately explored
entries.references: TIE, Advanced Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate basic understanding of calculus
entries.learning_activity: (b) Determine the nature of stationary points, rates of change between quantities, small changes in quantities, and series expansions of different functions

entries.main_competence: 3. Demonstrate mastery of advanced algebra
entries.specific_competence: 3.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of algebra
entries.learning_activity: Explore advanced tenets of algebra (series of squares and cubes of natural numbers, roots, quadratic and rational inequalities, 3x3 matrices, partial fractions, mathematical induction, and binomial theorem)
teaching_learning_activities: Think-Ink-Pair-Share: In groups, students discuss how to formulate the series of squares and cubes of natural numbers
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw, to discuss roots of polynomial functions, solution of quadratic and rational inequalities
Group discussion: In groups, students discuss 3x3 matrices, partial fractions, proof by mathematical induction, and binomial theorem and expansion
entries.assessment: Advanced tenets of algebra are properly explored
entries.references: TIE, Advanced Mathematics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
